item.tib: gab pa gsang chen las khro mchog lha rgod thog pa'i phywa tshe gsang ba'i sgrub pa
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ gab pa gsung chen khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i dmu zhags phya (phywa) tshe'i sgrub pa 'di yang / 'chi med yum sras gshen gsum sogs gdung rabs rim par brgyud nas/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud/ gshen po de yi rings dus dang rkyen gyis bstan pa rin po che gter du gshegs/ dus der cha gcig dang ra khyung rdzong la sbas/ cha gcig thugs la gab/ cha gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la gnyer du gtad/ phyis su snyigs dus kyi dbal bon khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i thugs las chad pa'i bu/ dbal 'bar stag slag can la srid pa'i rgyal mos snyan du brgyud pas mi nub dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu lags pa la/ dbal gshen de nyid gdul bya smin grol rgya che ba'i stabs kyis 'phro lus song bas/ rang la bon sgo 'di yi gnyer gtad yang yang byung ba dang / ma zad gyim shod shel brag 'jal (mjal) skabs yum chen srid rgyal khros ma'i tshul gyis gsang ba'i rag ta dmar pos bsre ba mdzad te bka' yis bkyon pa dang bcas te snyan du brgyud nas bdag la gdams pa'o/ phyis su smin grol gling du yi ger btab ste 'bri ba po thos chung sa trig ming gis bkrun (bskrun) pa'o//
